observations: Three vertical stacks of new-looking tyres.
Blue and white factory labels are attached to the treads of most tyres.
Left stack labels show 'SAILUN' and size '265/65R17'.
Middle stack labels show 'SAILUN' and size '235/60R18'.
Right stack labels show 'SAILUN' and size '265/70R17'.
The right stack features an All-Terrain (A/T) tread pattern, while the others appear to be highway or all-season treads.
A watermark 'NONNYBIG INTEGRATED' is visible across the center of the image.

claims.evidence: The brand name 'SAILUN' is clearly visible on the labels in photo 0.
While Sailun operates a factory in Cambodia, the specific country of manufacture is not legible on the sidewalls or labels in this photo.
The photo shows physical stock, but current inventory levels for specific sizes cannot be confirmed.

risks.proof: A clear photo of the 4-digit DOT code (week and year of manufacture) stamped on the tyre sidewall.
risks.if_unproven: as old stock (over 5 years), which significantly reduces safety and market value.

risks.proof: A video showing the tyre being inflated on a rim or a close-up of the inner liner to check for repairs.
risks.if_unproven: as having potential storage-related flat spots or internal belt issues.

proof_requests: A photo of the specific tyre size the buyer is interested in.
A clear close-up of the DOT code on the sidewall of that specific tyre to verify the manufacture date.
A photo of the full sidewall to confirm the exact model name (e.g., Terramax A/T, Atrezzo).
response.reason: The photo shows a variety of tyre sizes and tread patterns. A specific valuation is not possible until the buyer identifies the required size and the manufacture date (DOT code) is verified for that specific unit.
